svg.title: Plantiful physical IoT wiring draft
svg.desc: ESP32 shield and two breadboards, DHT11, PIR, LED with series resistor, soil and rain analogue modules. Rain uses GPIO35. Supply voltage and resistor value await confirmation.

g.text: D-02 | Review draft v1 | Rain AO confirmed as D35 | 28 October 2026
Dots mark endpoints. Crossing wires do not join.
Use the printed S / V / G labels.
D33 is not used in this build.
a-e linked per row | f-j linked per row
a-e linked per row | f-j linked per row
Jumpers use g in the same connected row.
DO pins are inserted but have no jumper.
D34 and D35 use S only
Their V and G stay empty
D26 S → 26a = 26b → resistor → 25b = 25e → LED anode (long leg)
= means an internal breadboard row link. The LED spans the centre gap.
User-supplied hole map, with D35 confirmed on 28 October 2026.
Confirm shield supply, split-rail continuity and resistor value.
Draft for user review. Editable vector source preserves this theme.
